Here are the main options we offer, in simple terms:

Discovery Sets & samples: Try our fragrances with feminine/masculine Discovery Sets, fully redeemable on a later full-size purchase, plus 2 complimentary samples.
Buying full-size online: Authentic products, free shipping to many countries in Europe, and exclusive website offers.
Finding your fragrance: Use our online fragrance finder experience, visit our stores, or authorized retailers.
Personalization: On our EU and US sites, many bottles (except Kalan) can be engraved with a short message.
Payment: PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, and American Express via secure operators.
Delivery choices: Free home delivery, with standard and express timelines depending on your country (including overnight options in the US).
Exclusive offers & gifts: Some offers let you add a gift after clicking a special email link and adding a full-size fragrance to your cart.
No separate free bottles: We do not offer complimentary full fragrances; Discovery Sets are the main way to explore the range.
Order changes: Once confirmed, orders cannot be modified or canceled, so details should be checked carefully before payment.
